nodes.label: Continual Learning Mechanisms Compose for Long-Horizon Memorization
nodes.author: Zheyuan Zhang; Alvin Zhang; Daniel Khashabi; Tianmin Shu
nodes.rationale: Tests whether combining complementary anti-forgetting mechanisms outperforms the best single one at a genuine 100-task horizon, since no standalone mechanism survives early successive-halving rounds.

nodes.label: Task-level successive halving (TSH) search
nodes.rationale: Ranking survivors by outcome at an early point in a long sequential process, rather than by iteration count, makes exhaustive 100-task search tractable; validated by 0.90-0.95 rank correlation with eventual outcomes.
